address: Adnan Menderes Caddesi No:89, Asarlik Mevkii PK 225, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
bio: The luxurious Caresse resort's Mediterranean restaurant offers a delightfully laid-back dining experience. Watch the chefs at work in the outdoor kitchen while cocktails are shaken in the bar and chill-out music fills the air. The view of the sea and the moored yachts never gets old! Seafood takes centre stage here, cooked up in traditional Greek and Italian ways. Wonderfully crispy deep-fried squid with a fresh tartar sauce, barbecued sea bass with perfectly seasoned vegetables: the best of Mediterranean cuisine served up without any fuss. Reserve a poolside spot ahead of time and enjoy a refreshing swim after dinner.
